items.q: What do I need to start sourcing from China?
items.a: Tell us what you need made or bought: the product or category, specifications, quantity, target price, destination and the delivery date you are aiming for. Submit a proposal request and our team will get back to you.

items.q: Can I use only some of your services?
items.a: Yes. Pick individual services, such as supplier verification or pre-shipment inspection, or choose Complete Sourcing Management and let us run the process from supplier identification to final receiving.

items.q: Do you inspect goods before they ship?
items.a: Yes. We inspect samples before production and check finished goods for quality and quantity before dispatch, and you receive written reports with the findings.

We coordinate dispatch, shipping and import documentation. Final customs clearance is usually handled by a licensed customs broker (CHA), and we can align the documents with yours. Tell us how you import today and we will confirm the setup.

items.q: How do I know the supplier is genuine?
items.a: Our verification covers capability assessment, factory audits, financial verification and a quality system review. You get a report with the results and recommendations before you place an order.

hero.title: Sourcing from China, without the guesswork.
hero.subtitle: For over a decade, IndoChinaBridge has helped businesses source machinery and products from verified Chinese factories — no unvetted suppliers, no hidden margins, just quality checked before it ships.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: Built to remove the risk from sourcing
story.paragraph1: IndoChinaBridge was founded to close the gap between Chinese manufacturing and global business needs. We saw the same problems again and again — language barriers, quality that's impossible to verify from abroad, and logistics that break down at the worst moment.
story.paragraph2: So we built a process around them: people on the ground who can walk a factory floor, inspections before anything ships, and one point of contact who answers when something needs to change.
story.point1: Verified supplier network across major manufacturing hubs
story.point3: Transparent pricing with no hidden margins
